description: Source code for AppDelegate.m, implementing application delegate and WKWebView delegate methods for a macOS application, including headless and headful browser window management, proxy configuration, and dialog handling.

classes.name: WebViewDialog
classes.description: Custom dialog class for handling JavaScript dialogs in WKWebView, managing webView reference and completion handler.

classes.name: BrowserAppDelegate
classes.description: Application delegate managing browser windows, headless mode, proxy settings, and WKWebView configurations.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the app delegate, parsing command-line arguments for URL, data directory, proxy, and mode settings.

methods.name: applicationDidFinishLaunching:
methods.description: Sets up the initial browser window or headless mode after app launch.

methods.name: createHeadlessPage:withURL:
methods.description: Creates a headless WKWebView inside a borderless window for background processing.

methods.name: createHeadfulPage:withURL:
methods.description: Creates a visible browser window with WKWebView for user interaction.

methods.name: proxyConfiguration:WithBypassList:
methods.description: Constructs proxy configuration dictionary based on server URL and bypass list.

methods.name: persistentDataStore
methods.description: Creates or returns a singleton WKWebsiteDataStore with optional custom data directory.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Returns a singleton WKWebViewConfiguration with preset preferences and process pool.

methods.name: createBrowserContext:WithBypassList:
methods.description: Creates a new browser context with its own data store and process pool.

methods.name: deleteBrowserContext:
methods.description: Removes a browser context by session ID.

methods.name: quit
methods.description: Terminates the application.

methods.name: webViewDidClose:
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a WKWebView is closed.

methods.name: webView:runJavaScriptAlertPanelWithMessage:initiatedByFrame:completionHandler:
methods.description: Displays a JavaScript alert dialog.

methods.name: webView:runJavaScriptConfirmPanelWithMessage:initiatedByFrame:completionHandler:
methods.description: Displays a JavaScript confirm dialog.

methods.name: webView:runJavaScriptTextInputPanelWithPrompt:defaultText:initiatedByFrame:completionHandler:
methods.description: Displays a JavaScript prompt dialog.

methods.name: _webView:runBeforeUnloadConfirmPanelWithMessage:initiatedByFrame:completionHandler:
methods.description: Handles before-unload confirmation dialogs.

methods.name: webView:handleJavaScriptDialog:value:
methods.description: Processes JavaScript dialog responses.

methods.name: webView:createWebViewWithConfiguration:forNavigationAction:windowFeatures:
methods.description: Creates a new WKWebView for pop-up or new window requests.

methods.name: webView:decidePolicyForNavigationAction:decisionHandler:
methods.description: Decides whether to allow or cancel navigation actions.

methods.name: webView:decidePolicyForNavigationResponse:decisionHandler:
methods.description: Decides whether to allow or download based on response headers.

methods.name: download:decideDestinationUsingResponse:suggestedFilename:completionHandler:
methods.description: Handles download destination decision.
